trainer/32223.htm.text: Master Duroga: Aden is said to be the center of culture and religion in this land. Indeed, it boasts some impressive sights, but I wonder if it really lives up to its reputation. Humans, I've discovered, have a way of singing their own praises regardless of the reality of the situation. Perhaps whe…

trainer/32223-noteach.htm.text: Master Duroga: You want to learn, eh? Do you think I have time to waste? Perhaps if you were a high-level Kamael, a Berserker or a Soul Breaker or even a Trooper. Since you are not, remove yourself at once!

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/2-01.htm.text: Master Duroga: Word has reached me that you are embarked on a quest to find the 6 Tablets of Vision. Prepare yourself -- this will not be an easy task. To simply find the Tablets is insufficient; you will need special Resonance Amulets to communicate with each Tablet. I can tell you the location of…

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/2-02.htm.text: Master Duroga: You don't have the Freezer ? See Information Broker Mist in the Hot Springs area!

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/2-03.htm.text: Master Duroga: Well done -- I see that you have brought back the instant freezer. Now, put the amulet in here... ...and there! It is ready. Now you may use it to communicate with the Tablet. Having done so, I suspect your path will become very clear.

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/2-04.htm.text: Master Duroga: Did you communicate with the Tablet of Vision located south of the Tower of Insolence ?

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/2-05.htm.text: Master Duroga: The first amulet has become white hot for no reason I can discern, rendering it unusable. If you borrow the freezer from the information desk at the spa, we may be able to correct the problem. Go there and tell them that I sent you.

Q00067_SagaOfTheDoombringer/2-06.htm.text: Master Duroga: The Tablets tend to attract their corresponding Amulets, which will reveal the location to you. After you have communicated with this Tablet, the location of the next Resonance Amulet will also be revealed to you. Through this process you will be able to acquire each of the Amulets i…

links.text: Ask about the Agathion in charge of skill enchantment.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
